scripts.name: Setup worktree
scripts.command: npm ci && python3.12 -m venv benchmark/.venv && benchmark/.venv/bin/python -m pip install -r benchmark/verify-requirements.txt

scripts.name: Check
scripts.command: test -x benchmark/.venv/bin/python || { echo 'benchmark/.venv missing: run Setup worktree'; exit 1; }; PATH="$PWD/benchmark/.venv/bin:$PATH" npm run check
